resolution.question: Will at least two-thirds of the 21-member Interchange Format Working Group return ballots on draft revision 4 by the close of the comment period?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 14 distinct members of the Interchange Format Working Group (two-thirds of 21) have returned ballots on draft revision 4 before or at 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
